rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: David’s فضل means prophethood; God also gave him the Psalms and subjected mountains, birds, and iron to him.
rows.anchor: النبوة والزبور وما سخر له من الجبل والطير والحديد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains are told to glorify with David, remembering the Lord with him through praise.
rows.anchor: سبحي معه مع داود، عليه السلام، يقول: اذكري الرب مع داود، وهو التسبيح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: David plaited iron like dough without fire and made long coats of mail.
rows.anchor: يضفر الحديد ضفر العجين من غير نار، فيتخذها دروعا طوالا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sabighat are long coats of mail. Earlier armor was hammered iron plates; David fastened mail with nails without hammering it with iron or heating it.
rows.anchor: وكانت الدروع قبل داود إنما هي صفائح الحديد مضروبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Size the nails to the mail: oversized nails break, while overly fine weaving lets them slip loose.
rows.anchor: قدر المسامير في الخلق ولا تعظم المسامير فتنقصم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s instruction to David’s household to do good means that they should say, “Praise be to God.”
rows.anchor: لآل داود: { واعملوا صالحا } يعني قولوا الحمد لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sees what David’s household does.
rows.anchor: إني بما تعملون بصير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon’s wind carried him and his company on a month-long journey from Jerusalem to Istakhr and back.
rows.anchor: غدوها شهر } يعني مسيرة شهر فتحملهم الريح من بيت المقدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wind did not displace birds above them or leaves below them, or raise dust as it carried them.
rows.anchor: لا تحول طيرا من فوقهم ولا ورقة من تحتهم ولا تثير ترابا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made a spring of copper flow for Solomon in Yemen for three days like water.
rows.anchor: يعني أخرجنا لسليمان عين الصفر ثلاثة أيام تجري مجرى الماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God subjected jinn to work before Solomon by his Lord’s permission.
rows.anchor: وسخرنا لسليمان من الجن من يعمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To deviate means to depart from Solomon’s command; such jinn were punished in this world by a king with a fiery whip.
rows.anchor: عن أمر سليمان، عليه السلام، { نذقه من عذاب السعير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shadow denotes Paradise and the scorching heat denotes Hell.
rows.anchor: ولا الظل } يعني الجنة { ولا الحرور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The living are believers and the dead are unbelievers; sight and blindness, light and darkness, and life and death picture believer and unbeliever.
rows.anchor: المؤمنين { ولا الأموات } يعني الكفار والبصير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God causes whom He wills to hear faith.
rows.anchor: إن الله يسمع } الإيمان { من يشاء

words: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍۢ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God likens living unbelievers who do not heed the call to faith to the dead in graves who cannot hear a summons.
rows.anchor: شبه الكافر من الأحياء حين دعوا إلى الإيمان فلم يسمعوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is only a messenger and warner.
rows.anchor: ما أنت إلا رسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad was sent as a true messenger, not pointlessly: he gives obedient people glad tidings of Paradise and warns disobedient people of the Fire.
rows.anchor: لم نرسك رسولا باطلا لغير شىء { بشيرا } لأهل طاعته

words: وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every earlier community had a messenger, except Muhammad’s community: no messenger came before Muhammad or will come after him until the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: لم يجئهم رسول قبل محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، ولا يجيئهم إلى يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This reassures Muhammad to be patient: he is not the first messenger to be rejected.
rows.anchor: يعزي نبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم ليصبر فلست بأول رسول كذب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clear signs were signs the messengers performed and reported about.
rows.anchor: بالآيات التي كانوا يصنعون ويخبرون بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The scriptures here are earlier sayings containing exhortations.
rows.anchor: وبالأحاديث التي كانت قبلهم من المواعظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The illuminating Book contains God’s commands and prohibitions.
rows.anchor: المضيء الذي فيه أمره ونهيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s reproach is His alteration of evil through punishment.
rows.anchor: كان نكير } [آية: 26] تغييري الشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fruits have differing colors, including white, red, and yellow.
rows.anchor: ثمرات مختلفا ألوانها } بيض وحمر وصفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountain judad are tracks in mountains, some white and some red, in varying colors.
rows.anchor: يعني بالجدد الطرائق التي تكون في الجبال منها أبيض وأحمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gharabib are tall and black.
rows.anchor: يعني الطوال السود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People, crawling creatures, and livestock vary in color—white, red, yellow, and black—as the fruits do.
rows.anchor: ومن الناس والدواب والأنعام } بيض وحمر وصفر وسود

words: إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording has fronting; those who know God are the people who fear Him most.
rows.anchor: فيها تقديم يقول: أشد الناس لله عز وجل خيفة أعلمهم الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is mighty in His dominion and forgiving of believers’ sins.
rows.anchor: في ملكه { غفور } [آية: 28] لذنوب المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Paradise praise God for removing grief because they did not know what He would do with them.
rows.anchor: الذي أذهب عنا الحزن } لأنهم لا يدرون ما يصنع الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is forgiving of great sins and appreciative even of small good deeds.
rows.anchor: للذنوب العظام { شكور } [آية: 34] للحسنات وإن قلت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muqatil also reports the view of monotheists guilty of major sins: appreciative means rewarding a weak, small deed.
rows.anchor: قول آخر شكور للعمل الضعيف القليل، فهذا قول أهل الكبائر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The abode of settlement is the eternal home, where inhabitants remain forever without dying or moving away.
rows.anchor: يعني دار الخلود أقاموا فيها أبدا لا يموتون ولا يتحولون عنها أبدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no bodily hardship in Paradise.
rows.anchor: لا يصيبنا في الجنة مشقة في أجسادنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no weariness in Paradise, unlike the fatigue of worship in this world.
rows.anchor: ولا يصيبنا في الجنة عيا لما كان يصيبهم في الدنيا من النصب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unbelievers are those who disbelieved in God’s oneness.
rows.anchor: والذين كفروا } بتوحيد الله { لهم نار جهنم

words: لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They neither die nor have punishment eased; this is how God repays every rejecter of faith.
rows.anchor: كذلك } هكذا { نجزي كل كفور } [آية: 36] بالإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “That” refers to night, day, sun, and moon running in God’s dominion according to His decree and creation.
rows.anchor: ذكر من الليل والنهار، والشمس والقمر يجرى فى ملكه بما قدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The moon grows through its stations, reaches fullness, then wanes toward the month’s end.
rows.anchor: فى السماء يزيد، ثم يستوى، ثم ينقص فى آخر الشهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The old arjun is a dried, curved date stalk a year old; the waning moon returns to a threadlike shape.
rows.anchor: أول ما استهل فيه كالعرجون، يعنى العذق اليابس المنحنى

words: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun does not catch the moon to shine alongside it; the sun rules the day and moon the night.
rows.anchor: فتضيء مع القمر، لأن الشمس سلطان النهار، والقمر سلطان الليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night does not overtake day: darkness does not overcome daylight.
rows.anchor: ولا يدرك سواد الليل ضوء النهار، فيغلبه على ضوئه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sun and moon move in orbits, passing beneath earth in the west, emerging in the east, crossing the sky, and setting in the west; their course continues until Resurrection.
rows.anchor: فى دوران يجرون يعنى الشمس والقمر يدخلان تحت الأرض من قبل المغرب، فيخرجان من تحت الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is to warn people with the Qur’an’s threats.
rows.anchor: يعنى لتنذر يا محمد بما فى القرآن من الوعيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The living person is someone whom God knows to be guided.
rows.anchor: من كان حيا } من كان مهديا في علم الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word due upon unbelievers is punishment for rejecting God’s oneness.
rows.anchor: ويجب العذاب { على الكافرين } [آية: 70] بتوحيد الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Meccans pass destroyed towns day and night, morning and evening, while traveling to Syria for trade; they should reflect.
rows.anchor: على القرى نهارا وليلا وغدوة وعشية، إذا انطلقتم إلى الشام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jonah is Jonah son of Matta, from Nineveh, and was one of the Children of Israel.
rows.anchor: وهو ابن متى من أهل نينوى { لمن المرسلين } [آية: 139] كان من بنى إسرائيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The laden ship was full of people and animals.
rows.anchor: الموقر من الناس والدواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jonah entered the ship, covered his head, and slept at its side; God assigned it a whale called al-Lakhm, and the ship stopped, alarming people who feared drowning.
rows.anchor: فاحتبست سفينتهم ولم تجر، فخاف القوم الغرق، فقال بعضهم لبعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jonah identified himself as the wanted man and asked to be thrown overboard; the crew refused because he was God’s messenger, then drew names in water three times, each time finding Jonah’s name, before casting him in.
rows.anchor: قال: أنا المطلوب أنا يونس بن متى، فاقذفونى فى البحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before Jonah was thrown, God had not told the whale what to do; when Jonah was two spans from the water, God made its belly a place of worship and forbade it to harm his hair or skin or give him food or drink.
rows.anchor: لى من عبدى حاجة إن لم أجعل عبدى لك رزقا، ولكن جعلت بطنك له مسجدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Water and wind challenged Jonah about fleeing, saying they worshipped the One worshipped in heaven and earth and feared His punishment; Jonah remembered his deeds until God inspired his call.
rows.anchor: أين أردت أن تهرب؟ من الذى يعبد فى السماء والأرض، فوالله إنا لنعبده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jonah called on God, declaring there is no god but Him, declaring Him pure and admitting he was among the wrongdoers.
rows.anchor: فنادى بالتوحيد، ثم نزه الرب عز وجل، أنه ليس أهل لأن يعصى، ثم اعترف، فقال:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jonah drew lots and was the one defeated by the draw.
rows.anchor: يعنى فقارعهم فكان من المقروعين المغلوبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The whale swallowed Jonah.
rows.anchor: فالتقمه الحوت وهو مليم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muqatil glosses mulim as surrendering himself to his Lord.
rows.anchor: يعنى استلام إلى ربه

rows.speaker: الفراء
rows.claim: Al-Farra says alama means a man has deserved blame, while mulim describes him as blameworthy.
rows.anchor: قال الفراء: ألام الرجل إذا استحق اللوم وهو مليم

rows.speaker: الفراء
rows.claim: Al-Farra also says one may be blamed for an act one committed; Muqatil then returns to his own explanation.
rows.anchor: وقال أيضا: وليم على أمر قد كان منه، فهو ملوم على ذلك، رجع إلى قول مقاتل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before his sin Jonah was among those who prayed; he was devoted to prayer and remembrance of God.
rows.anchor: يعنى من المصلين قبل المعصية، وكان فى زمانه كثير الصلاة والذكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Without that devotion Jonah would have remained in the whale as punishment until people are raised from their graves.
rows.anchor: عقوبة فيه { إلى يوم يبعثون } [آية: 144] الناس من قبورهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The taghut here are idols; Muqatil notes that the word is feminine.
rows.anchor: الذين اجتنبوا الطاغوت } يعنى الأوثان، وهى مؤنثة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They turned from worshipping idols back to worshipping God.
rows.anchor: ورجعوا من عبادة الأوثان إلى عبادة الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The glad tidings are of Paradise, and the servants are to be told this good news.
rows.anchor: لهم البشرى } يعنى الجنة { فبشر عباد } [آية: 17] فبشر عبادى بالجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The saying they hear is the Qur’an.
rows.anchor: الذين يستمعون القول } يعنى القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They follow the Qur’an’s best part, obedience to God, rather than prohibited acts; this is obedience in what God revealed.
rows.anchor: يعنى أحسن ما فى القرآن من طاعة الله عز وجل، ولا يتبعون المعاصى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God guided them to His religion.
rows.anchor: أولئك الذين هداهم الله } لدينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are people of understanding because they follow God’s commands and prohibitions instead of evil attributed to others.
rows.anchor: يعنى أهل اللب والعقل حين يستمعون فيتبعون أحسنه من أمره ونهيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book sent down to Muhammad is the Qur’an.
rows.anchor: أنزلنا عليك الكتاب } يعنى القرآن { للناس بالحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever is guided by the Qur’an benefits himself; whoever strays from faith in it bears the sin of his own error.
rows.anchor: بالقرآن { فلنفسه ومن ضل } عن الإيمان بالقرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Overseer means one who dominates or controls them; Muqatil says the sword verse abrogated this.
rows.anchor: يعنى بمسيطر نسختها آية السيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God takes each soul when its appointed term arrives, meaning the soul for which He decreed death.
rows.anchor: يقول: عند أجلها، يعنى التى قضى الله عليها الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul that has not died is the other soul, which God returns to the body.
rows.anchor: والتي لم تمت في منامها } فتلك الأخرى التى يرسلها إلى الجسد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These signs prompt reflection on resurrection.
rows.anchor: لقوم يتفكرون } [آية: 42] فى أمر البعث

words: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَٰٓءَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This was revealed about Meccan unbelievers who claimed angels could intercede for them.
rows.anchor: نزلت فى كفار مكة زعموا أن للملائكة شفاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question challenges whether the supposed intercessors own any intercession or understand their worshippers worship them; there is a parallel in al-An‘am.
rows.anchor: يعنى إن { كانوا لا يملكون شيئا } من الشفاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The consequences were punishment for shirk; they cannot outpace God to escape recompense for their evil deeds.
rows.anchor: عقوبة ما كسبوا من الشرك { والذين ظلموا من هؤلاء سيصيبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God expands provision for whom He wills and constricts it for whom He wills; these are signs for believers in His oneness.
rows.anchor: يعنى يوسع { الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر } يعنى ويقتر على من يشاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After seven years of hardship rain came; Muqatil says this admonished the Meccans to learn and affirm God’s oneness.
rows.anchor: حين مطروا بعد سبع سنين فقال: { أولم يعلموا أن الله يبسط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This was revealed about Meccan polytheists after Wahshi, client of al-Mut‘im ibn ‘Adi ibn Nawfal, asked how to repent. After 25:68 and 25:70 were revealed, he accepted Islam; Meccans objected that his repentance was accepted but theirs was not addressed.
rows.anchor: فقال وحشى، مولى المطعم بن عدى بن نوفل: إنى قد فعلت هذه الخصال فكيف لى بالتوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their excess means shirk, murder, and adultery; no sin is greater excess than shirk.
rows.anchor: يعنى بالإسراف: الشرك والقتل والزنا فلا ذنب أعظم إسرافا من الشرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not despair of God’s mercy, as they thought they had no repentance.
rows.anchor: يقول: لا تيأسوا { من رحمة الله } لأنهم ظنوا ألا توبة لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For those who repent, God forgives the sins mentioned in al-Furqan—shirk, murder, adultery—and calls them to repent.
rows.anchor: يعنى الشرك والقتل والزنا الذى ذكر فى سورة الفرقان { إنه هو الغفور الرحيم } [آية: 53] لمن تاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Return from sins to God and submit to Him by devoting worship exclusively to monotheism.
rows.anchor: يقول: وارجعوا من الذنوب إلى الله { وأسلموا له } يعنى وأخلصوا له بالتوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repent before punishment comes, for then you will not be protected from it.
rows.anchor: من قبل أن يأتيكم العذاب ثم لا تنصرون } [آية: 54] يعنى لا تمنعون من العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Follow the Qur’an’s best, meaning its teachings on obedience in lawful and unlawful matters, before sudden punishment arrives while you are unaware.
rows.anchor: من القرآن { من ربكم } يعنى ماذكر من الطاعة من الحلال والحرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hasrata means “O my regret.”
rows.anchor: أن تقول نفس يحسرتا } يعنى يا ندامتا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To have fallen short means to have neglected something.
rows.anchor: على ما فرطت } يعنى ما ضيعت { في جنب الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “In God’s side” means with respect to God, specifically in remembrance of Him.
rows.anchor: في جنب الله } يعنى فى ذات الله يعنى من ذكر الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The regretful person mocked the Qur’an in this world.
rows.anchor: يعنى لمن المستهزئين بالقرآن فى الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further regretful claim is that, had God guided the speaker, he would have been among the God-fearing.
rows.anchor: أو تقول لو أن الله هداني لكنت من المتقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A return is a return to worldly life; the speaker would do good, meaning become a monotheist.
rows.anchor: أو تقول حين ترى العذاب لو أن لي كرة } يعنى رجعة إلى الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s signs that had come to the denier are the Qur’an’s signs.
rows.anchor: بلى قد جآءتك آياتي } يعنى آيات القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The denier said the signs were not from God and arrogantly refused to believe them, becoming an unbeliever.
rows.anchor: فكذبت بها } أنها ليست من الله { واستكبرت } يعنى وتكبرت عن إيمان بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On Judgment Day, those who lied about God did so by claiming He had a partner; their faces will be blackened.
rows.anchor: ترى الذين كذبوا على الله } بأن معه شريكا { وجوههم مسودة أليس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The arrogant are those who reject monotheism, and Hell is their abode.
rows.anchor: يعنى مأوى { للمتكبرين } [آية: 60] عن التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blind person is an unbeliever and the sighted a believer; they do not equal one another in merit.
rows.anchor: الأعمى } يعنى الكافر { والبصير } يعنى المؤمن

words: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَلَا ٱلْمُسِىٓءُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A virtuous believer and sinful unbeliever likewise do not equal one another in merit.
rows.anchor: يعنى وما يستوى فى الفضل المؤمن المحسن، ولا الكافر المسيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour is certainly coming, with no doubt; most Meccans do not believe in resurrection.
rows.anchor: يعنى كائنة لا شك فيها { ولكن أكثر الناس لا يؤمنون } [آية: 59] يعنى كفار مكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to call upon God is addressed to the people of Yemen.
rows.anchor: وقال ربكم } لأهل اليمن: { ادعوني أستجب لكم } ، ثم ذكر كفار مكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being arrogant toward God’s worship means being arrogant toward monotheism; Meccan unbelievers will enter Hell humbled.
rows.anchor: يستكبرون عن عبادتي } يعنى عن التوحيد

words: جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made night for rest and day bright for seeking provision; this is His favor.
rows.anchor: الله الذي جعل لكم الليل لتسكنوا فيه والنهار مبصرا } لابتغاء الرزق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most people, meaning Meccan unbelievers, do not thank their Lord for blessings by affirming His oneness.
rows.anchor: لا يشكرون } [آية: 61] ربهم فى نعمه فيوحدونه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s created works make His oneness known, even though people do not see Him.
rows.anchor: أن يعرف التوحيد بصنعه، وإن لم تروه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth is dry, dusty, broken up, and without vegetation.
rows.anchor: متهشمة غبراء لا نبت فيها

words: فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rain makes the dead earth live and sprout; it shakes with greenery and increases its plants.
rows.anchor: فأنبتت و { اهتزت } بالخضرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The One who revived earth after death will revive the dead in the Hereafter, teaching anyone who doubts resurrection.
rows.anchor: إن الذي أحياها } بعد موتها، { لمحي الموتى } في الآخرة، ليعتبر من يشك في البعث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has power over resurrection and everything else.
rows.anchor: إنه على كل شيء قدير } [آية: 39] من البعث وغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person deviating from God’s signs is Abu Jahl, who turns from belief in the Qur’an through poetry and falsehood.
rows.anchor: يعني أبا جهل، يميل عن الإيمان بالقرآن، وبالأشعار والباطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “They are not hidden from Us” refers to Abu Jahl.
rows.anchor: لا يخفون علينا } ، يعني أبا جهل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one thrown into the Fire is Abu Jahl, while the one secure on Judgment Day is the Prophet.
rows.anchor: أم من يأتي آمنا يوم القيامة } ، يعني النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s command to the Meccan unbelievers to do as they wish is a threat; He sees their shirk and other deeds.
rows.anchor: لكفار مكة: { اعملوا ما شئتم } ،هذا وعيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “He prescribed for you” means He made religion clear; another explanation is that He established Islam’s precedents, and min is an extra particle.
rows.anchor: يقول: بين لكم، ويقال: سن لكم آثار الإسلام

words: مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًۭا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is fronting: the enjoinder to Noah and revelation to Muhammad precede the enjoinder to Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, followed by the command to establish religion.
rows.anchor: فيه تقديم، { وما وصينا به إبراهيم وموسى وعيسى أن أقيموا الدين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Establishing the religion means affirming monotheism.
rows.anchor: أن أقيموا الدين } ، يعنى التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command not to divide in religion was difficult for Meccan polytheists because Muhammad called them to monotheism, as in their objection at 38:5.
rows.anchor: كبر على المشركين } يقول: عظم على مشركى مكة، { ما تدعوهم إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God chooses and draws people to His religion.
rows.anchor: الله يجتبي إليه } ، يقول: يستخلص لدينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God guides to His religion those who turn back in repentance.
rows.anchor: إلى دينه، { من ينيب } [آية: 13]، يعنى من يراجع التوبة

words: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever people are given is only a brief enjoyment of worldly life.
rows.anchor: تتمتعون بها قليلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What is with God is better than worldly provision and more lasting; these people believe and trust in their Lord.
rows.anchor: وما عند الله خير } مما أوتيتم فى الدنيا، { وأبقى } وأدام { للذين آمنوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A major sin is any sin whose punishment ends in the Fire.
rows.anchor: يقول: كل ذنب يختم بنار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Indecencies are acts for which a legal penalty is imposed in this world.
rows.anchor: ما يقام فيه الحد فى الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When angry they overlook wrongs, restrain anger, and pardon; this was revealed about Umar ibn al-Khattab when insulted in Mecca, and relates to 45:14.
rows.anchor: نزلت فى عمر بن الخطاب بن نفيل بن عبد العزى بن فرط بن رازح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Responding to their Lord means responding in faith.
rows.anchor: والذين استجابوا لربهم } ، فى الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Establishing prayer means completing the five daily prayers; this was revealed about the Ansar, who maintained them.
rows.anchor: وأقاموا الصلاة } ، يقول: وأتموا الصلوات الخمس، نزلت فى الأنصار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before Islam and before the Prophet came to Medina, the Ansar gathered to consult and act on a decision; God praised this practice.
rows.anchor: كانت قبل الإسلام، وقبل قدوم النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم المدينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They spend their wealth in obedience to God.
rows.anchor: ومما رزقناهم } من الأموال، { ينفقون } [آية: 38] فى طاعة الله

words: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلْبَغْىُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wronged person, such as someone wounded, may retaliate against the wrongdoer by equivalent retribution.
rows.anchor: يعنى المجروح ينتصر من الظالم، فيقتص منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Batsh means strength; God destroyed people stronger than earlier rejecters.
rows.anchor: أشد منهم بطشا } ، يعني قوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The precedent of earlier peoples is their punishment for rejecting messengers; Muhammad’s community faces the same pattern of destruction.
rows.anchor: في العقوبة، حين كذبوا رسلهم، يقول: هكذا أمتك يا محمد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If Muhammad asks the Meccan unbelievers who created the heavens and earth, they answer that the Mighty in dominion and Knowing of His creation created them.
rows.anchor: يقول لنبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم: لئن سألت كفار مكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made the earth a bed or floor for people.
rows.anchor: الذي جعل لكم الأرض مهدا } ، يعني فرشا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The paths are routes people travel.
rows.anchor: وجعل لكم فيها سبلا } ، يعني طرقا تسلكونها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The paths let people recognize their routes.
rows.anchor: لعلكم تهتدون } [آية: 10]، يقول: لكي تعرفوا طرقها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The measured water from heaven is rain.
rows.anchor: والذي نزل من السماء ماء بقدر } ، وهو المطر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God revived a dead, barren town with water and plants grew there; people likewise emerge from the earth as plants.
rows.anchor: فأحيينا به، يعني بالماء بلدة ميتا لا نبت فيها، فلما أصابها الماء أنبتت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pairs are all kinds or categories.
rows.anchor: يعني الأصناف كلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ships are vessels, and livestock are camels and cattle; these are things people ride.
rows.anchor: يعني السفن، { و } من { والأنعام } يعني الإبل والبقر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “So that you may settle” means “so that you may sit”; the backs are male and female camels.
rows.anchor: لتستووا } ، يعني لكي تستووا، { على ظهوره } ، يعني ذكورا وإناثا من الإبل

words: ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mounted on their backs, riders remember their Lord’s blessing by saying, “Praise be to God.”
rows.anchor: ثم } قال: لكي { تذكروا نعمة ربكم إذا استويتم عليه } ، على ظهورها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who subjected the mount made the vehicle docile for riders.
rows.anchor: وتقولوا سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا } ، يعني ذلل لنا هذا المركب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muqrinin means capable of mastering or controlling the mount.
rows.anchor: وما كنا له مقرنين } [آية: 13]، يعني مطيقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People will return to their Lord.
rows.anchor: وإنا إلى ربنا لمنقلبون } [آية: 14]، يعني لراجعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They assigned God a share from His servants, meaning a child: they claimed the angels were God’s daughters, an evident act of disbelief.
rows.anchor: وجعلوا له } ، يقول: وصفوا له { من عباده } من الملائكة، { جزءا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question uses fronting and challenges whether God took daughters from His creation, citing one raised in finery and inarticulate in dispute.
rows.anchor: فيها تقديم واستفهام اتخذ مما يخلق من

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question rebukes them for claiming God took daughters while He singled them out for sons.
rows.anchor: وأصفاكم بالبنين } [آية: 16]، يقول: واختصكم بالبنين

words: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The likeness they attributed to the Merciful was the claim that angels were God’s daughters.
rows.anchor: والمثل زعموا أن الملائكة بنات الله تعالى

words: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muqatil relates their distress at news of a daughter to 16:58, exposing their hypocrisy in assigning God what they disliked for themselves.
rows.anchor: إذا بشر أحدهم بما ضرب للرحمن مثلا } ، يعني شبها، والمثل زعموا أن الملائكة بنات الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rhetorical question denies giving them an earlier scripture that instructed worship of someone besides God.
rows.anchor: يقول أعطيناهم، { كتابا من قبله } ، من قبل هذا القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This was revealed about Quraysh leaders al-Walid ibn al-Mughira, Sakhr ibn Harb, Abu Jahl ibn Hisham, and Rabi‘a’s sons ‘Utba and Shayba.
rows.anchor: نزلت في الوليد بن المغيرة، وصخر بن حرب، وأبي جهل بن هشام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Umma here means a religious way or community.
rows.anchor: إنا وجدنا آباءنا على أمة } ، يعني على ملة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prosperous among earlier peoples who made this claim were tyrants and leading figures.
rows.anchor: مترفوها } ، يعني جباريها وكبراءها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earlier communities imitated their ancestors’ deeds just as Meccan unbelievers did.
rows.anchor: بأعمالهم كما قال كفار مكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur’an is an honor for Muhammad and those in his community who believe.
rows.anchor: يقول: القرآن لشرف لك، { ولقومك } ، ولمن آمن منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will be asked in the Hereafter about those who disbelieved in the Qur’an.
rows.anchor: وسوف تسألون } [آية: 44] في الآخرة عن من يكذب به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those sent before Muhammad means the communities to whom earlier messengers were sent.
rows.anchor: واسأل من أرسلنا } ، يعني الذين أرسلنا إليهم، { من قبلك

words: أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةًۭ يُعْبَدُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is to ask believing People of the Book whether any messenger taught worship of deities besides God; none did.
rows.anchor: سل يا محمد مؤمنى أهل الكتاب هل جاءهم رسول يدعوهم إلى غير عبادة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The criminals are profligate polytheists, and remaining in Hell means they do not die.
rows.anchor: يعني المشركين المسرفين، { في عذاب جهنم خالدون } [آية: 74]، يعني لا يموتون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their punishment does not lessen for even an instant.
rows.anchor: لا يفتر عنهم } ، العذاب طرفة عين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They despair of every good, are certain of punishment, receive tidings of evil, have blue eyes and black faces.
rows.anchor: يعني آيسون من كل خير مستيقنين بكل عذاب، مبشرين بكل سوء، زرق الأعين، سود الوجوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not punish them without cause; they were the wrongdoers.
rows.anchor: فنعذب على غير ذنب، { ولكن كانوا هم الظالمين } [آية: 76]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Malik is the keeper of Hell.
rows.anchor: وهو خازن جهنم، فقال: ماذا تريدون؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Hell ask Malik to have their Lord put an end to them; Malik stays silent forty years until God orders a reply that they will remain in punishment.
rows.anchor: فيسكت عنهم مالك، فلا يجيبهم مقدار أربعين سنة، ثم يوحي الله تعالى إلى مالك بعد أربعين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The truth brought to them in this world was monotheism; most of them hated it.
rows.anchor: لقد جئناكم بالحق } في الدنيا، يعني التوحيد، { ولكن أكثركم للحق كارهون
